notes.title: UPDATE 16th of March, 2017 - Peripherals
notes.notes:
UPDATE 16th of March, 2017
We have released a second patch, in order to address peripherals that weren't working yet.

ORIGINAL POST
We have recently published an update to solve some recent issues with several supported driving wheels. 
If you still have issues after the patch, please report in the comments.
Here is the list of brands and models involved:

Thrustmaster T150 Racing Wheel
Thrustmaster T300RS Racing Wheel
Thrustmaster TX Racing Wheel
Thrustmaster F340 Force Feedback
Thrustmaster T500RS Racing Wheel
Thrustmaster RGT Force Feedback Pro

Logitech G25 Racing Wheel
Logitech G27 Racing Wheel
Logitech Driving Force GT
Logitech Driving Force PRO
Logitech G29 Driving Force Racing Wheel
Logitech G920 Driving Force Racing Wheel

Fanatec 911 GT2 EU
Fanatec 911 GT3 RS
Fanatec 911 Turbo S
Fanatec ClubSport Wheel V2

notes.notes:

The PC Patch is OUT NOW!

- Minor Fixes

Thanks for your support and HAVE FUN!

Milestone Team

notes.title: PC Patch Coming Soon
notes.notes:
Hi Gamers, we are finalizing the PC Patch that will be released this week.
We are actually working on fixing the saves data issues.
Please follow the guidelines below in order to avoid any problem with your saves data:
Create a backup of the saves folder into your hard disk.
Here the patch where you’ll find the folder à %AppData%\Milestone
Thanks for your understanding and support,

Find more

Milestone Team

notes.title: Announced the demo of Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO STEAM™ Version
notes.notes:
http://sebastienloebrallyevo.com/wp-content/uploads/thumb-demo-montecarlo.jpg

Milestone is glad to announce that, starting from today, 21th January 2015, will be downloadable a DEMO on STEAM™. The release date of the Game is officially scheduled on 29th January 2016 for PS4™, Xbox One® and Windows PC/STEAM™.

Demo will include the following contents: 

Track: 	

    Montecarlo – Sisteron

Cars:	

    Mini Cooper S (70s)
    Peugeot R5
    Polo Rally Car

Game mode:	

    Rally single stage
    Playground Time Attack and Challenge Time Attack – a technical location where the player can test the reactions of the car on different surfaces like asphalt and dirt road


Visit our Official YouTube Channel to watch the new video!

Milestone Team

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.notes:
http://i59.tinypic.com/a5e2yv.jpg

THE NEW MILESTONE IP WILL BE AVAILABLE "EARLY 2016"

Hi Gamers,

Milestone announces that Sébastien Loeb Rally Evo, originally scheduled for release on October 2015, now will be available “Early 2016”.

“Sébastien Loeb Rally EVO is the biggest project ever made by Milestone since now. We’ve decided to postpone it to focus more on the title development. This release date change will offer to the players a rally simulation that represents a higher quality on the videogame experience”, affirms Luisa Bixio, V.P. Milestone.

Remember to follow us on:
-	Facebook
-	 Official Youtube Channel 
-	 Milestone Tweets  on #SLRallyEvo
-	 Official Website  

Milestone Team
